paragraphs.heading: A seventh grade lesson
paragraphs.edited: I remember even back when I was in seventh grade, many years ago, I was told something by my teacher. I looked up and saw this chart of a monkey suddenly becoming more and more, evolving into a man, and I remember looking at that and thinking, how can that be? I remember raising my hand and asking the question, saying this doesn't seem right. And I'll never forget what she said to me. It seemed to solve it for me. She said, "I get what you're saying, but that is religion and faith, and this is science." Even right there as a seventh grader, the dichotomy, the split, the two separate spheres of life were defined for me.
